ud7.2:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekho 'ti {maññamāno} bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
ud7.2:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekho 'ti {maññamāno} bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandassentaṃ samādapentaṃ samuttejentaṃ sampahaṃsentaṃ.
ud7.2:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud7.2:4.1: {acchejji} vaṭṭaṃ {vyagā} nirāsaṃ, visukkhā saritā na sandati, chinnaṃ vaṭṭaṃ na vattati, es' ev' anto dukkhassā 'ti. ||2||
